release_notes: Dynadot, a safe MCP for large accounts, and a smoother move off Keitaro. New Dynadot integration (accounts by API key, balance, domain import, buy-and-park, automatic A records) that never breaks a zone: domains on their own name servers are left alone, a Dynadot DNS zone keeps its other records, calls are serialised per key. MCP: orbitra_list_campaigns is compact with id/domain filters and paging (it returned 1.4 MB for 360 campaigns), stats moved to orbitra_campaigns_stats, new bulk_set_campaign_domain moves any number of campaigns in one call, and update_campaign no longer re-creates streams, drops their names, turns OR filters into AND or resets offer selection and the bot challenge. Keitaro migration: .sql.gz uploads import again, the dump command works with MariaDB in Docker, step 3 builds the scp commands from the server IP. A slow domain save no longer 504s the whole panel (session lock released, 180 s nginx timeout, PHP-FPM pool sized from RAM), nginx rebuilds no longer run certbot per domain, the geo updater keeps IP2Location/IP2Proxy databases, install works on Ubuntu 26.04 and when re-run from /var/www/orbitra. Also: geo banner while Sypex is the only database, settings menu fits every locale, uk/zh wording fixes, /favicon.ico on panel hosts only. Migration 57 adds the dynadot_accounts table; update as usual. To get the bigger PHP-FPM pool on an existing server, re-run the installer or raise pm.max_children in the pool config.
